title: Plum Graphite
summary: A sophisticated graphite-and-plum palette with lavender focus cues and soft neutral text.
details: Plum Graphite gives TheoX a quieter editorial character. Graphite foundations prevent the purple family from becoming decorative, while lavender accents make navigation, references, and active research controls easy to find.
features: Graphite foundations with restrained plum depth
Lavender focus cues for navigation and active controls
Soft neutral typography for editorial and manuscript work
